finding_summary: RagFlags::initFromRequest() blindly trusts client-supplied X-RAG-FLAGS headers, allowing any untrusted caller to turn off safety boundaries, input sanity, and premise verification.

test_records.detail: External client successfully injected 'X-RAG-FLAGS: ENABLE_PREMISE_VERIFIER=false'. The server honored the override.

test_records.description: Disable curriculum boundary safety gate via X-RAG-FLAGS
test_records.detail: External client successfully injected 'X-RAG-FLAGS: ENABLE_CURRICULUM_BOUNDARY=false'. The server honored the override.

test_records.description: Disable non-lexical input sanity check via X-RAG-FLAGS
test_records.detail: External client successfully injected 'X-RAG-FLAGS: ENABLE_INPUT_SANITY=false'. The server honored the override.

test_records.description: Force static K by disabling dynamic K via X-RAG-FLAGS
test_records.detail: External client successfully injected 'X-RAG-FLAGS: ENABLE_DYNAMIC_K=false'. The server honored the override.

test_records.description: Disable semantic concept reranker via X-RAG-FLAGS
test_records.detail: External client successfully injected 'X-RAG-FLAGS: ENABLE_SEMANTIC_RERANK=false'. The server honored the override.
